t: GO Introduces Giga-Speed Internet as Standard for Maltese Businesses
html:
In line with its mission to drive a truly digital Malta, GO plc is making giga-speed internet the entry point for all business customers, with six months completely free for new Business Plus subscribers to its standalone Business Connect or Business Pro offer.

This launch marks a significant evolution in GO’s business portfolio and the recognistion that today, fast, reliable connectivity is no longer a luxury but a fundamental business need.

“Every business in Malta should enjoy Giga speeds on our state-of-the-art True Fibre network. That’s not an aspiration, it’s a baseline. Such speeds represent a significant leap in connectivity capability, enabling businesses to handle high-bandwidth demands such as cloud computing, video conferencing, large file transfers and so much more, without compromise,” explained Ayrton Caruana, Chief of GO Business.

“By making Giga-speed internet our new entry point and offering it free for the first six months, we are removing every barrier that stands between a Maltese business and its full potential,” added Mr Caruana.

Subscribers to GO’s new Business Plus offer will also benefit from exclusive access to GO’s dedicated Business Customer Care line, ensuring priority support from specialists who understand the demands of running a business.

GO’s Business Plus offering includes further business-enabling benefits including GO’s Easybuy giveing business customers access to flexible device financing on critical IT equipment and hardware, making it easier to invest in the tools required to operate and grow.

Through GO’s collaboration with Klikk, businesses will also benefit from exceptional offers on device purchases, providing access to the latest technology, at highly competitive prices. Customers will also be supported by specialised technical experts, offering guidance in the design, setup, and ongoing management of their networking infrastructure, ensuring a seamless and scalable connectivity experience tailored to their business needs.

“We know that investing in the right technology can be a major commitment for businesses. With our Easybuy facility, we make it easier to access essential hardware without the upfront burden because the right tools should never be out of reach. Connectivity, however, is only as strong as the expertise behind it, which is why our specialised teams design, set up, and manage networking infrastructure to deliver a seamless, scalable experience that grows with our customers’ businesses,” said Mr Caruana.

These initiatives reflect GO’s broader mission to build a digital Malta where no one is left behind. As a key partner to local businesses, GO is committed to supporting their growth with tailored solutions, strong infrastructure, and accessible high-speed connectivity.

“Our success is tied to our customers’ success. When Maltese businesses thrive, Malta thrives,” Mr Caruana concluded.

Backed by Malta’s only True-Fibre-powered infrastructure and three submarine cables, including the island’s sole connection to mainland Europe, GO delivers the network reliability that businesses can depend on.

The offer is available now. Businesses interested in experiencing the GO difference can visit go.com.mt/business for more information.
